cases.title: Pro Honda scooter oil · 1L
cases.market: Valenzuela City, Metro Manila · Shopee Philippines
cases.saleEvidence: The retrieved Shopee product page displays a peso offer, two variations, Philippine seller location and shipping information. The exact selected variant and physical stock were not independently verified.
cases.observationMethod: Public search-rendered product page and exact seller image inspected. A direct fresh fetch failed; this is a retrieved listing observation, not proof of today's stock.
cases.sourceFreshness: Search retrieval inspected 16 Oct 2026; source indexed last month. Direct fresh fetch unavailable. Stock today unverified.
cases.imageAlt: Exact Shopee seller image showing a Pro Honda 1L scooter oil bottle and a car-use promotional graphic
cases.imageCaption: Actual seller image · wording mismatch flagged for review

quotes.label: Seller graphic
quotes.text: Provide the best performance for your beloved car.

cases.finding: The photographed bottle is scooter oil, while the same seller graphic promotes car use. This is a concrete presentation inconsistency. The displayed ₱215 offer is also below a separate ₱430 retail listing for 1L blue scooter oil; variants, vouchers and seller costs can explain price differences. Neither issue authenticates the contents.
cases.limits: Potential misdescription or reused template, not a confirmed counterfeit. Two variations are present. The supplier, batch code, authorization and purchased contents have not been checked. No current inventory confirmation.
nextSteps: Match the selected variant, bottle size and JASO grade before comparing prices.
Ask a qualified Honda reviewer to inspect supplier records, tamper evidence and batch markings.
If warranted, purchase a sample through an authorized process for packaging and oil analysis.

references.label: Separate retail comparator · ₱430 / 1L
references.note: Blue 10W30 MB scooter oil, SKU 08234-2MB-K1LP. A retail comparison only; it is not an official Honda list price or proof of a fake.

cases.title: Honda oil filter · public counterfeit warning
cases.seller: 811 Motorcycle Parts · publisher named in post
cases.market: Honda Rebel Club Philippines · Philippine motorcycle audience
cases.saleEvidence: The public post warns about filters sold online and promotes the publisher's own genuine-parts shop. The pictured alleged counterfeit is not linked to a named seller. It does not establish an active counterfeit sale today.
cases.observationMethod: Public Facebook post body and both original attached comparison images retrieved and visually inspected.
cases.sourceFreshness: Post and attached photos retrieved 16 Oct 2026. Publication date not established; this may be an older warning. Current sale of the pictured item is unverified.
cases.imageAlt: Original 811 Motorcycle Parts Facebook graphic alleging a Honda oil filter is fake, with pictured filter, packaging and batch code
cases.imageCaption: Publisher's allegation · not authenticated by Honda

quotes.label: Post warning
quotes.text: beware of FAKE Honda Oil Filters online

cases.finding: A Philippine motorcycle community post shows a filter and packaging the publisher calls fake, alongside its claimed genuine comparison. The graphic identifies a repeated batch code and print alignment as review points. This is a specific visual allegation to validate, not an independent finding against a seller.
cases.limits: The publisher sells parts and has a commercial interest. No suspect seller URL, authenticated sample, Honda confirmation or current stock evidence is provided. Country of manufacture alone must never be treated as evidence of counterfeiting.
nextSteps: Validate the pictured part number and batch markings with Honda.
Request the original suspect listing and purchase documentation through an approved investigation.
Treat the publisher's comparison as an unverified report until a sample is authenticated.

additionalImages.alt: Original companion Facebook image labelled genuine by 811 Motorcycle Parts
additionalImages.caption: Companion image labelled genuine by the publisher; independently unverified.

cases.platform: New Star Commercial · Philippine web shop
cases.title: XRM 110 connecting rod · 06381-KPH-900
cases.market: Philippine storefront · Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao shipping
cases.scope: Honda XRM 110 motorcycle genuine spare parts · Philippines
cases.saleEvidence: The product page displays the connecting-rod kit, a peso price and order/shipping information for Philippine regions. Stock and checkout were not tested.
cases.observationMethod: Fresh public product-page extraction and the exact seller product image visually inspected.
cases.sourceFreshness: Direct public product content retrieved 16 Oct 2026. Price at capture; physical stock and authenticity untested.
cases.imageAlt: Actual New Star Commercial product photograph of a Honda XRM 110 connecting rod kit with 06381-KPH-900 packaging
cases.imageCaption: Actual product photo · reference offer, no adverse evidence
cases.signal: Genuine-parts offer retained as a reference
cases.finding: A specific in-scope Honda motorcycle spare part is visibly offered through a Philippine web shop. No product-specific counterfeit indicator was established. This reference demonstrates that the watch preserves genuine-claim listings without automatically accusing a seller.
cases.limits: This is not a suspect seller finding. A genuine claim, photo and part number do not independently authenticate the supplied item. Generic navigation labels for other products are excluded from the assessment.
nextSteps: Preserve part number, listing photo and invoice if the part is sampled.
Use Honda's authorized-dealer information and packaging checks for verification.
Escalate only if product-specific evidence emerges.
